clues: This town is one of the big towns of its land, on the mid coast. Its port and rail line make it a hub for trade and trips.
Most rain falls in the fall, from September to November. The dry spell runs from February to April.
In 1997 this town split from the province it had shared. It came to be run by the central state on its own.
In 2017 this town held a big meet of the heads of lands from all round the Pacific rim.
This is the fourth most peopled town in its land. It is the second town of its land by sheer size of ground.
